scenario: A browser attaches session cookies automatically. How do you protect a state-changing endpoint from CSRF?
rubric: Explain why authenticated cookies alone do not establish user intent.
Validate an appropriate CSRF token tied to the authenticated context.
Describe origin checks or SameSite as defense in depth rather than universal replacements.
Explain the approach in a clear sequence with assumptions and an example.
misconceptions: A state-changing GET is safe because it has no request body.
